verdict.rationale: Ollama ships its own way to chat with models directly inside the product: `ollama run` / 'run and chat with Gemma 4', plus a native macOS/Windows app that users report handles multimodal input and Markdown. That is a built-in assistant, but there is no evidence it can take on and carry out delegated tasks agentically. The agent capabilities on offer (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode via `ollama launch`, and OpenClaw) are third-party agents that Ollama launches or powers, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a first-party agent that executes delegated multi-step tasks, tool use or actions by the built-in assistant, and documentation of the app's assistant capabilities beyond basic chat.
